Jhaṅkārakaravīratantra
in 8000 ślokas, treats 28 karmas. See Nepal I. Preface p. lxii. [Page382-b]
Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p. 17.
--Caṇḍakāpālinyāḥ saṅkṣepapūjāvidhi from. Nepal I. p. 181.

Jhaṅgu
ins. poet, son of Bhaṭṭa Mamma; a. of Kalyāṇpūr ins. of Kaḍacchi of Guhila dynasty of Kiṣkindhā; 7th or 8th Cent.
See Epi. Ind. XXXV. p.. 58-9.
